paper_title: Excess Electronic Recoil Events in XENON1T
notes: Paper reports a 3D 90% confidence surface for solar axion couplings (g_ae, g_ae*g_an^eff, g_ae*g_agamma), inscribed in cuboid g_ae<3.8e-12, g_ae*g_an^eff<4.8e-18, g_ae*g_agamma<7.7e-22 GeV^-1. This is a solar axion search (couplings, not vs mass), plus a 3.4 sigma EXCESS rather than clean exclusion. The g_ae bound is a single coupling value not a mass-vs-coupling curve. The bosonic dark matter section (ALPs/dark photons vs mass between 1-210 keV) gives true mass-coupling limits but that data is not numerically tabulated in the provided content. Data is therefore not in standard (mass_eV, coupling) form; confidence kept low due to excess interpretation and ambiguity of which result to extract.
